character.corpseorigin.mortal.desc: An ordinary mortal with no special abilities. Normal infection rate.
character.corpseorigin.baixiaofei.desc: Protagonist of Zombie Brother. He enters the zombie plague to save Xiao Wei and eventually becomes a guardian of Yanhuang.
character.corpseorigin.baixiaofei.trait1: Killing Bloodline: Awakened combat power far beyond ordinary
character.corpseorigin.baixiaofei.trait2: Protagonist's Luck: More likely to retain consciousness after infection
character.corpseorigin.heixiaofei.desc: Protagonist of the Corpse Nest War arc and a clone of Bai Xiaofei. Bearing the Slaughter and Vampire bloodlines, he is the core fighter of the arc.
character.corpseorigin.heixiaofei.trait1: Slaughter Bloodline: Combat power surges in Slaughter Momentum, wrapped in red-crimson killing aura
character.corpseorigin.heixiaofei.trait2: Dark Siphon: Drains enemies' blood essence to heal, but is backlashed by bosses
character.corpseorigin.heixiaofei.trait3: Black Gold Heart: Locks health before a lethal blow and blasts nearby enemies away
limb.corpseorigin.severed: Your %1$s was severed! Flesh begins to regrow...
limb.corpseorigin.starving: Too hungry - the flesh stops growing
character.corpseorigin.longyou.desc: The Zombie King of Zombie Brother. He created the zombie plague and seeks to rule the world.
character.corpseorigin.longyou.trait1: Undying Skeleton Body: Cannot die even if beheaded; true body is the Origin Body
character.corpseorigin.longyou.trait2: Zombie King's Power: Controls Zombie brothers with infrasound
character.corpseorigin.longyou.trait3: Source of Infected Water: Fully immune to infected water
character.corpseorigin.xiaolu.desc: A character from Zombie Brother. After swallowing Medusa's Snake Eye, she gained the power of life element recombination.
character.corpseorigin.xiaolu.trait1: Life Element Recombination: Osmium metallization and Osmium Ice Shuttle, but costs great stamina
character.corpseorigin.xiaolu.trait2: Child's Constitution: Slightly lower infection rate than normal
character.corpseorigin.weixin.desc: A character from Zombie Brother, nicknamed Xiaomeng. Former Holy Maiden of the Blood Lotus Cult, with two personalities and nearly 60 years of cultivation.
character.corpseorigin.weixin.trait1: Dual Personalities: The younger sister is fragile and pure; the elder sister is cruel and warlike
character.corpseorigin.weixin.trait2: Blood Lotus Art: Internal energy manifestation and Blood Lotus Golden Petals
character.corpseorigin.weixin.trait3: 60 Years of Cultivation: Lower infection rate than normal
character.corpseorigin.shichaozhizi.desc: The hidden final boss of the Corpse Nest War arc. Once the young cult leader of the Blood Lotus Cult, he was given half of Long You's undying blood and became a Corpse Brother, strengthened by the blood and qi of ten thousand people.
character.corpseorigin.shichaozhizi.trai: Blood Lotus Armor: Below half health he enters phase two with greatly boosted attack and defense
Undying Blood Split: After defeat, his upper and lower halves keep fighting separately
Son of the Corpse Nest: A hidden boss condensed from ten thousand people's blood and qi
character.corpseorigin.kaiweinai.desc: Bai Xiaofei's cousin and captain of the youth anti-pickpocket squad. During the Corpse Nest War he became the key figure who called Hei Xiaofei's humanity back.
character.corpseorigin.kaiweinai.trait1: Black Knight Constitution: Slow passive regeneration, and one in-place revival at half health on death
character.corpseorigin.kaiweinai.trait2: Tentacles: Melee reach +2, can pull nearby items or enemies
character.corpseorigin.kaiweinai.trait3: Key Story Character: Sacrifices himself to awaken Hei Xiaofei's humanity
character.corpseorigin.xiaoyanzi.desc: Bai Xiaofei's childhood friend. During the Corpse Nest War he protects Xiao Lu, filling the support and escape role.
character.corpseorigin.xiaoyanzi.trait1: Ham: Summons the fire-breathing lizard Ham to fight alongside
character.corpseorigin.xiaoyanzi.trait2: Run Away Passive: +1 speed while allies are nearby
character.corpseorigin.xiaoyanzi.trait3: Support / Escape Role: A key figure of the ship's guard line
character.corpseorigin.tianxianbaobao_zb: The opening mini-boss of the Corpse Nest War, wearing a Teletubbies costume that gives off a strong sense of oppression.
Opening Mini-boss: An iconic, oppressive monster
Suck: Grabs players in melee and drains them continuously; allies can interrupt it to free them
Ear-eye Bug Messenger: Reports via ear-eye bugs (passive scene hint only)
character.corpseorigin.jingang_zb.desc: A high-tier monster summoned by Long You (second-stage Vajra Corpse Infant) and an iconic siege enemy inside the Corpse Nest.
character.corpseorigin.jingang_zb.trait1: Iron Body: The second stage is immune to normal attacks from the front; the head is its weak point
character.corpseorigin.jingang_zb.trait2: Advanced Frenzy: After being worn down in stage one, it evolves, clearing debuffs and healing 50%
character.corpseorigin.jingang_zb.trait3: Siege Foe: Killed by a headshot from Hei Xiaofei in the original story
character.corpseorigin.xiaohui.desc: The central hostage of the Life-and-Death Chess Game, used by Long You as the black general piece. A story NPC with no combat ability.
character.corpseorigin.xiaohui.trait1: Central Hostage: Used as the black general piece in the chess game
character.corpseorigin.xiaohui.trait2: No Combat Ability: Only drives the plot forward
character.corpseorigin.xiaohui.trait3: Story-prop NPC: Needs a base model and frightened idle animation
character.corpseorigin.tushu.desc: A mainstay of the Yanhuang Special Ability Squad. In the Corpse Nest War he was parasitized and drained by the young cult leader, becoming a tragic figure implanted with a Blood Demon Seed.
character.corpseorigin.tushu.trait1: Yanhuang Special Squad Mainstay: Skilled in squad martial arts
character.corpseorigin.tushu.trait2: Defense Stance: Greatly reduces damage for a short time
character.corpseorigin.tushu.trait3: Tragic Figure: Parasitized and drained by the young cult leader (Blood Demon Seed)
character.corpseorigin.muxi.desc: A member of the Yanhuang Special Squad Second Team and the core of the Five Elements Formation. A key team support who lost his right ear and both eyes to the Son of the Corpse Nest.
character.corpseorigin.muxi.trait1: Five Elements Formation Core: Team buffs and area control
character.corpseorigin.muxi.trait2: Wood Binding: Roots enemies in place with vines
character.corpseorigin.muxi.trait3: Tragic Exit: Maimed by the Son of the Corpse Nest
character.corpseorigin.yanyan.desc: A member of the Yanhuang Special Squad Second Team and the core of the reverse Five Elements Formation, who heavily wounded the young cult leader with a giant fireball and saved Uncle Tu.
character.corpseorigin.yanyan.trait1: Reverse Formation Core: Can unleash a giant suppressing fireball
character.corpseorigin.yanyan.trait2: Rescuer: Heavily wounds the young cult leader and saves Uncle Tu
character.corpseorigin.yanyan.trait3: Second Team Member: Fights alongside Mu Xi
Leader of the eastern ninja, sent by Emperor Xu Fu to capture the Zombie King aboard the Daitengu. After his defeat he was implanted with a Blood Demon Seed.
Tengu Divine Ward: An ultimate formation that counters the Undying Waist
Red Meteor Sword: A blade specialized against the Zombie King
Defeated and Parasitized: Ultimately implanted with a Blood Demon Seed
character.corpseorigin.k.desc: Speaker of the European Dark Council and a vampire. He wants to drink Long You's blood for greater power, fighting throughout and saving the day several times.
character.corpseorigin.k.trait1: Vampire Constitution: High-speed movement and passive regeneration
character.corpseorigin.k.trait2: Bat Cloak: Binds and controls enemies
character.corpseorigin.k.trait3: Core Reinforcement: Turns the tide at several key moments
character.corpseorigin.bianselong_zb.des: The key ambusher of the Corpse Nest arc. He disguised himself as Xiao Hui and crushed Hei Xiaofei's heart, a turning point of the whole story.
character.corpseorigin.bianselong_zb.tra: Disguise: Can switch to Xiao Hui's appearance and infiltrate
Dual-form Model: Its own form and Xiao Hui's disguise
character.corpseorigin.chongmu.desc: Ruler of the Flesh Forest and source of the swarm disaster, trading human hostages for nutrients.
character.corpseorigin.chongmu.trait1: Summon Swarm: Commands red fire ants and giant bullet ants
character.corpseorigin.chongmu.trait2: Bag Capture: Binds and poisons victims with a sack
character.corpseorigin.chongmu.trait3: Ruler of the Flesh Forest: Source of the swarm disaster
character.corpseorigin.qingwa_zb.desc: A monster unique to the Life-and-Death Chess Game whose gas stimulated Hei Xiaofei's Slaughter Momentum, directly triggering its awakening.
character.corpseorigin.qingwa_zb.trait1: Killing Aura Gas: Amplifies Slaughter Momentum and triggers frenzy in an area
character.corpseorigin.qingwa_zb.trait2: Chess Game Monster: Stimulates the awakening of Hei Xiaofei's Slaughter Momentum
character.corpseorigin.qingwa_zb.trait3: Poison Gas Particles: Its gas clouds are the core visual
character.corpseorigin.hujie.desc: A plot-guiding NPC who coerces Hei Xiaofei into meeting the Zombie King with hostages. She has no combat skills.
character.corpseorigin.hujie.trait1: Plot-guiding NPC: Coerces Hei Xiaofei with hostages
character.corpseorigin.hujie.trait2: No Combat Ability: Only drives the plot forward
character.corpseorigin.hujie.trait3: Threatening Dialogue: Needs a base model and dialogue performance
character.corpseorigin.zuohufa.desc: A trusted follower of the Zombie King, assigned to give Bai Xiaofei's original body his final test on the south side.
character.corpseorigin.zuohufa.trait1: South Blockade: Locks down an area and summons minions
character.corpseorigin.zuohufa.trait2: Zombie King's Confidant: Prepares the final test for Bai Xiaofei
character.corpseorigin.zuohufa.trait3: Corpse Camp: A stationary blocking boss
A grunt of the Dark Council merged from Jack and Laura, sharing one attendant model and a basic combat animation set.
Council Grunt: The two separate characters were merged
Generic Melee/Ranged Attack: No unique skill
Shared Attendant Model and Basic Combat Animations
character.corpseorigin.xiongxing_zb.desc: A bear-type Corpse Brother merged from Bear Da and Bear Er, both sharing one skill and model logic.
character.corpseorigin.xiongxing_zb.trai: Two characters share one skill set and model logic
Bear Charge: A reckless melee burst
Bear Physique: High health and high knockback resistance
character.corpseorigin.chongqun.desc: The Bug Mother's summoned swarm, merged from red fire ants and giant bullet ants, overwhelming targets with numbers and poison.
character.corpseorigin.chongqun.trait1: Bug Mother's Summon: Both insects share one summon skill, differing only in looks
character.corpseorigin.chongqun.trait2: Group Melee: Overwhelms targets with numbers
character.corpseorigin.chongqun.trait3: Poison/Explosive Damage: Bites apply negative effects
character.corpseorigin.siyangyuan_zb.des: A guard Corpse Brother of the zoo breeding ground with no unique skill, only a generic melee attack.
character.corpseorigin.siyangyuan_zb.tra: No Unique Skill: Generic melee attack
Base Model and Melee Attack Animation
character.corpseorigin.kuaidiyuan_zb.des: A Corpse Brother that raids the ship's guard line, able to deal simple explosive damage with parcels.
character.corpseorigin.kuaidiyuan_zb.tra: Parcel Bomb: Throws parcels for simple explosions
Raider of the ship's guard line
character.corpseorigin.zhaoritian.desc: He appears on the ship's guard line and saves Chun'er and Zhao Rihua from the Courier Corpse Brother.
character.corpseorigin.zhaoritian.trait1: Power Strike: An exclusive instakill story skill
character.corpseorigin.zhaoritian.trait2: Arrives to Save the Day: Rescues the attacked crew
character.corpseorigin.zhaoritian.trait3: Highlight Entrance: Needs an exclusive entrance cutscene
character.corpseorigin.chuangshang_xingc: A generic survivor NPC merged from Chun'er and Zhao Rihua, with no skills beyond story appearances.
Two characters merged into a generic survivor NPC
character.corpseorigin.bianyi_guiyu.desc: A mutant aquatic monster that fights Bai Xiaofei's original body in the opening, skilled at underwater ambushes and bites.
character.corpseorigin.bianyi_guiyu.trai: Underwater Ambush: An exclusive water combat bite
Aquatic Monster: Moves and attacks underwater
The opening foe of Bai Xiaofei's original body
character.corpseorigin.yanhuang_budui.de: A unified troop template merged from the Tianxiao warship crew, with no combat skills and mainly garrison placeholder shots.
character.corpseorigin.yanhuang_budui.tr: All soldiers merged into one unified troop template
No Combat Skills: Garrison placeholder shots only
Tianxiao Warship Crew: The symbol of H City's reclamation
skill.corpseorigin.water_orb.desc: Fire a water orb that knocks back and briefly slows on hit. Cooldown 8s.
skill.corpseorigin.spatial_blink.desc: Blink 8–16 blocks, leaving a spatial ripple at the landing point. Cooldown 15s.
skill.corpseorigin.undying_chest.desc: Passive: Continuous regeneration, and one headshot-revival phase when health runs out.
skill.corpseorigin.corpse_king_thunder.d: Grab and paralyze in melee, or call down lightning on the target area. Cooldown 10s.
skill.corpseorigin.water_pollution.desc: Passive: water sources you pass through are polluted into infected water.
skill.corpseorigin.blood_lotus_armor.des: Passive: Below half health he enters phase two with greatly boosted attack and defense.
skill.corpseorigin.ground_burrow.desc: Burrow underground and burst out beneath a player for heavy damage. Cooldown 20s.
Raise an invincible frontal shield for 5s, during which you cannot attack. Cooldown 20s.
skill.corpseorigin.dog_eye_cannon.desc: Fire Ham to inflict confusion and explosive damage. Cooldown 12s.
skill.corpseorigin.ham_summon.desc: Summon the fire-breathing lizard Ham to spit fireballs. Cooldown 10s.
skill.corpseorigin.escape_passive.desc: Passive: +1 speed while allies are nearby.
skill.corpseorigin.life_drain_suck.desc: Grab the nearest target in any direction and drain continuously (the tentacle turns toward it); can be interrupted to free them. No cooldown.
skill.corpseorigin.life_drain_suck.no_ta: There is nothing nearby to grab
skill.corpseorigin.life_drain_suck.speci: Special blood (%s) — the boost lasts longer!
skill.corpseorigin.antenna_block.desc: Passive: 30% chance to block damage from axes and arrows/thrown weapons entirely. Active: raise the antenna immediately and block all such damage for %s seconds. 12s cooldown.
skill.corpseorigin.antenna_block.activat: Antenna up! Guaranteed block for %s seconds
skill.corpseorigin.iron_body.desc: Passive: Immune to normal attacks from the front; only hits on the head weak point work.
skill.corpseorigin.pounce_combo.desc: Three consecutive pounces that inflict bleeding on hit. Cooldown 8s.
skill.corpseorigin.chameleon_disguise.de: Take on Xiao Hui's appearance to infiltrate near the target. Cooldown 30s.
skill.corpseorigin.heart_grab_ambush.des: Exclusive story skill: crush the target's heart up close for lethal damage. Cooldown 60s.
skill.corpseorigin.killing_gas.desc: Exhale stimulating gas that amplifies Slaughter Momentum and triggers frenzy in an area. Cooldown 15s.
skill.corpseorigin.special_forces_combat: The special squad's basic melee combo. Cooldown 3s.
skill.corpseorigin.defense_stance.desc: Enter a defensive stance that greatly reduces damage for a short time. Cooldown 15s.
skill.corpseorigin.five_elements_formati: Deploy the Five Elements Formation, buffing allies and suppressing enemies inside. Cooldown 30s.
skill.corpseorigin.wood_bind.desc: Bind the target in place with vines. Cooldown 10s.
skill.corpseorigin.reverse_formation_fir: The reverse formation unleashes a giant fireball for wide suppression damage. Cooldown 30s.
skill.corpseorigin.tengu_divine_array.de: Activate the ultimate secret formation, countering the Undying Waist and suppressing targets inside. Cooldown 90s.
skill.corpseorigin.meteor_sword.desc: Swing a blade forged from the red meteor, specialized against the Zombie King. Cooldown 30s.
skill.corpseorigin.bat_cloak.desc: Turn into a bat cloak to bind and control enemies in range. Cooldown 15s.
skill.corpseorigin.blood_wing_blade.desc: A heavy blood-blade melee strike that drains life. Cooldown 10s.
skill.corpseorigin.south_blockade.desc: Block off an area and summon minions to bar the way. Cooldown 30s.
skill.corpseorigin.summon_swarm.desc: Summon swarms of red fire ants and giant bullet ants. Cooldown 30s.
skill.corpseorigin.bag_capture.desc: Capture a target in a sack, binding it and inflicting poison damage. Cooldown 20s.
skill.corpseorigin.bear_charge.desc: Charge forward, sending enemies on the path flying. Cooldown 10s.
skill.corpseorigin.swarm_bite.desc: Group melee bites that inflict poison or explosive damage. Cooldown 2s.
skill.corpseorigin.parcel_bomb.desc: Throw a parcel that causes a simple explosion. Cooldown 10s.
skill.corpseorigin.power_strike.desc: An exclusive instakill story skill that can one-shot grunt targets. Cooldown 20s.
skill.corpseorigin.water_bite.desc: Ambush and bite a target underwater. Cooldown 6s.

The sword intent dissipates, and the landscape returns to its place.
skill.corpseorigin.blood_cloud.desc: Manifest internal energy into a blood-red cloud that rushes at enemies, damaging and knocking back those in a frontal cone.
skill.corpseorigin.blood_lotus.desc: Unleash the Blood Lotus Art, releasing petal attacks centered on yourself that deal heavy damage and knockback.
skill.corpseorigin.slaughter_momentum.de: Enter the Slaughter Awakening · Red Armor killing aura state, greatly boosting all attributes for 12 seconds at the cost of continuous hunger.
skill.corpseorigin.dark_siphon.desc: Drain the blood essence of nearby enemies to heal yourself; siphoning boss-level targets backlashes, disabling the drain and hurting you.
skill.corpseorigin.black_gold_heart.desc: Passive: on lethal damage, lock health at 1 and blast nearby enemies away (60s cooldown).
skill.corpseorigin.severed_arm_strike.de: Grab the target ahead with a severed arm, dealing heavy damage and slowness while pulling it toward you.
Dual-form melee: Tiger Claw strikes a target ahead with weakness; with no target ahead, Bee Wheel spins to sweep surrounding enemies.
skill.corpseorigin.hound_unleashed.desc: Dash forward like a hound, knocking back and damaging enemies along the path.
skill.corpseorigin.round_dance.desc: Spin to blast nearby enemies away and slow them, gaining brief resistance and speed to break out of encirclement.
skill.corpseorigin.killing_incarnation.d: Manifest killing intent into a blood-red incarnation that fights alongside you.
skill.corpseorigin.killing_incarnation.n: The blood-red incarnation is not implemented yet...
skill.corpseorigin.slaughter_awakening.d: Briefly awaken the Killing Bloodline, gaining Strength II for 10 seconds.
skill.corpseorigin.corpse_king_infrasoun: Release the Zombie King's infrasound, summoning 2 Lower-level Corpse Brothers nearby.
skill.corpseorigin.osmium_gold.desc: Turn your body into osmium gold, gaining Resistance II for 10 seconds.
skill.corpseorigin.osmium_ice_spike.desc: Fire an osmium ice shuttle, dealing 8 damage to the target hit by your line of sight.
